blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, ORIENTAL MINDORO, Philippines — A bird of prey has been rescued after it was found floating in the waters off Santa Fe town in Romblon province and was immediately turned over to environmental officials for assessment and care. The raptor, locally known as a “lawin or banog,” was spotted over the weekend by Ricky Malacad, a resident of Inobahan in Poblacion at San Jose town, while he was fishing near Sitio Puro in Santa Fe.
